s: Junimo Chests are purchasable storage items that function similarly to chests, although instead of maintaining an individually managed inventory, all Junimo Chests share one global inventory of nine spaces. Any item(s) placed in one Junimo Chest can be accessed by the player from any other Junimo Chest.
. The first two chests can be purchased for 30 Qi Gems. After buying the first two, additional chests can be purchased for 15 Qi Gems each.
Much like regular chests, Junimo Chests must be empty to be removed, and can be placed in many different places throughout the Stardew world. However, if a Junimo Chest is left in the
it will be moved out of the way.
